domain.text: Model request-cost accounting, including per-request prompt-size pricing tiers and OpenCode history polling.

impressions.text: The work adds tiered per-request pricing and caching for OpenCode and Claude usage, with lower-bound estimates when usage history is genuinely unavailable.
The worker reported broad automated verification, including 1,051 passing tests, and a successful live smoke after the history-pagination fix.

Review caught that polling fetched only a recent message window, leaving older requests untiered and making complete sessions appear as lower bounds; the reported fix followed older-history cursors and added a multi-page regression test.
The orchestrator reported green CI and matching live-session costs after the fix; the PR was graded and merged.
